description: Health-bar wobble regression AT ZOOM 4, the case the 1x fixture cannot see. One SELECTED ARMCOM walks a short 180-wu-per-axis diagonal centred on a pinned camera, so it stays inside the viewport at 4x. The defect this catches is a bar quantised in PRE-zoom units: its step on screen is `zoom` px, invisible at 1x and 4 px here. The oracle is the bar against ITSELF -- a unit walking at constant speed gives a near-zero second difference, a quantised bar gives one the size of the grid. shootall off, noshake on, a far CORE keepalive. tools/barwobble.sh.
